title: kbingest.module_digest skips a package a non-package group mapper imports from its own directory, so a change to that package leaves a stale cached map
goal: kbingest.module_digest of a mapper module that is no package also covers the modules of a package imported from the mapper's directory, so a change to helpers/__init__.py moves the digest

run:
import sys,tempfile,pathlib,importlib
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import kbingest
d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
(d/"helpers").mkdir()
(d/"helpers"/"__init__.py").write_text("X = 1\n")
(d/"rvmapper.py").write_text("import helpers\n")
sys.path.insert(0,str(d))
m=importlib.import_module("rvmapper")
a=kbingest.module_digest(m)
(d/"helpers"/"__init__.py").write_text("X = 2\n")
b=kbingest.module_digest(m)
sys.exit(0 if a!=b else 1)
